'''Tulu Kinn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] member of the [[Broken Columns Clan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], and the brother of [[Drola Kinn]]. Tulu was present during the [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] between his clan and the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], when the two clans joined to form the [[Bright Sun Clan]].
